decisions.reason: This burner component is a low-visibility add-on to the firm's core radiant heater business, so little investment is at stake, but it supports established products and costs little to keep.
The firm presents this multi-model electric infrared line as a flagship of its direction, so the visible commitment and investment make persisting with it very likely.
It has a page of its own and fits the electrification direction, but as a single non-flagship product with little public commitment it is the most expendable of the electric line.
This multi-model industrial hall heater line sits close to the core business and to the firm's electrification strategy, so the invested resources and its fit argue for keeping it.
The hydrogen-ready series was publicly launched in real-world operation and is central to the announced low-carbon direction, so escalation of commitment makes dropping it very unlikely.
